title: Edge-chromatic number of odd complete graphs
statement: For every integer $n \ge 1$, the complete graph $K_{2n-1}$ on $2n-1$ vertices has edge-chromatic number equal to $2n-1$; that is, its edges can be properly coloured with $2n-1$ colours but no fewer. Equivalently, the chromatic number of the line graph of $K_{2n-1}$ is $2n-1$.
